name: Apurata
all_locations: Lima, Callao Region, Peru; Lima, Lima Province, Peru
long_description: We offer instant underwriting of financing at the point of sale (ecommerce or physical) focused on small purchases ($100-$1000).

Experienced software developer, continuosly learning.
